about: Caddy adds `Via: 1.1 Caddy` to every proxied response as well as to the requests it forwards; upstreamer adds Via to forwarded requests only. RFC 9110 §7.6.3 requires a gateway to send Via on the requests it forwards and leaves it free to send one on responses, which would only tell clients about the fleet's internals.

about: Caddy lowercases the Upgrade token in both directions (`derp`); upstreamer forwards the client's and the origin's `DERP` as sent.

Errors raised by the file server (404, 405) or an `error` step carry the site headers; Caddy's bare error responses carry none of its `header` fields. upstreamer's answer is the intended one: site headers apply to every response.

about: An error answer drops every header operation of the main route's steps. Caddy drops only its deferred ones (a `header` block that deletes a field, or `defer`) and keeps immediate ones, so its heimdall 404 for a missing hashed asset says `public, max-age=31536000, immutable` and its portfolio 405 keeps the page's Vary. upstreamer's answer is the intended one: a cache must not keep a 404 for a year, and a 405 does not vary on what the page did.
A 404 page served by an error route has no ETag and no Accept-Ranges; Caddy's file_server adds its default ETag and Accept-Ranges to the custom-status page.

Caddy adds `Vary: Accept-Encoding` to every answer of a route with encode or precompressed; upstreamer adds it only when the answer can differ by Accept-Encoding (a sidecar exists, or the encode step compresses the response for some Accept-Encoding). Nothing a client receives depends on the missing token.

about: A site header replaces the origin's field of the same name; Caddy's immediate `header` operations add to the origin's fields, so its client receives two X-Frame-Options values.
A Host no site serves gets 404; Caddy answers 200 with an empty body.
A request without Host gets 400 from both; Caddy's carries a text body, upstreamer's is empty.

about: Caddy on macOS takes the type of .ico from /etc/apache2/mime.types (image/x-icon), which overrides the mailcap table nixpkgs builds Go with. On the fleet's NixOS hosts Caddy sends mailcap's image/vnd.microsoft.icon, the registered type, as upstreamer does.

On a case-sensitive file system /BLOG names no file, so both answer with the 404 page, which has no ETag and no Accept-Ranges as the 404-page finding records. macOS folds case and serves the blog page to both.
